# ship-artifacts

Your interface to the `artifacts` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`artifacts.list`](references/docs/artifacts.list.mdoc) — Artifact metadata records, filterable by scope/mime/collection/item/owner.
- [`artifacts.watch`](references/docs/artifacts.watch.mdoc) — Live watch — typed patch stream for artifact metadata changes.

## Commands

- [`artifacts.delete`](references/docs/artifacts.delete.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Soft-delete an artifact by id.
- [`artifacts.patch`](references/docs/artifacts.patch.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Patch an artifact's metadata (name / owner / expiry).
- [`artifacts.promote`](references/docs/artifacts.promote.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Promote an artifact to a target scope (run → project → user).
